summary: Configured node1 as the EL7-compatible FreeRADIUS server for node2. Authentication, rejection behavior, handover integrity, and persistence across sequential node restarts were verified.
actions_performed: Installed FreeRADIUS 3.0.13 EL7 packages without changing RHEL 7.9 or kernel 3.10.0-1160.
Configured a generated, dedicated node2 client secret and loaded the demonstration user from access.txt.
Enabled radiusd, opened UDP/1812, and restricted the client definition to node2.
Verified correct credentials return Access-Accept, an incorrect password returns Access-Reject, and an incorrect client secret is not accepted.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.
Confirmed the handover files remained byte-for-byte unchanged on both nodes.

evidence.requirement: Dedicated node2 RADIUS client and demonstration user from access.txt
evidence.summary: Configuration validation succeeded; radiusd is enabled and listening; the client is node2-only and the configured user matches access.txt.
Correct credentials produced Access-Accept, an incorrect password produced Access-Reject, and an incorrect client secret was not accepted before and after restarts.

evidence.requirement: Preserve operating-system release and kernel with legacy-compatible software
evidence.summary: FreeRADIUS 3.0.13 EL7 packages are installed; both nodes remain RHEL 7.9 with kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64.
Initial and final SHA-256 hashes match on both nodes for access.txt and client-notes.txt.
Captured healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered radiusd/listener/data, and successful post-restart authentication.
Captured healthy client baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered tools/data/secret, and successful post-restart authentication.
